pairs.subject: public-verdict-badge
pairs.evidence: app/embed/zebricek/route.ts:40 The endpoint publicly caches resolved, customized and unavailable renders identically, allowing failures and caller-specific output to persist in shared caches.

techniques.evidence: features/landing/referendum/embed.ts:66 Rendering fixes score colours to palette constants; the typed builder accepts no colour override, validates weights through the shared codec, escapes output and bounds row counts.

features/landing/referendum/aggregate.ts:61 This aggregate counts submitted votes, not impressions; searches for impression, referrer, referer, reach and view-count constructs found no embed-reach measurement in the context or its delivery routes.

features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:94 Custom weights are explicit, but published default weights are omitted despite being a supported meaning-bearing parameter, so an existing snippet inherits later changes to the published weights.

features/landing/referendum/ogPayload.ts:108 The leaderboard loader returns null for both an empty corpus and caught failures; this mapping collapses them into one nodata outcome instead of preserving unknown versus unavailable.
app/embed/zebricek/route.ts:40 Both nodata and customized renders return 200, receiving the resolved public cache policy rather than transient-failure and private-customization policies.

features/landing/referendum/embed.ts:151 Custom scores contain only the number, with their qualification in a separate banner and their distinction in a colour class, so cropped values lose the qualification and non-colour distinction.
